```yaml
# .github/workflows/pr-tests.yml
on: pull_request_target

```yaml
# .github/workflows/release.yml
on:
  push:
    tags: ['v*']
jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/cache@v4

Verdict REJECTED. Recommendation: run untrusted PR code under pull_request without cache writes to release keys, and drop cache restore from the publish job.
